c1.text: Hey Devin. Let's build a game. An arcade game called Jumpy Otter, with Expo, so one codebase runs on iOS, Android, and the web.

chunks.text: Hey Devin. Let's build a game.
An arcade game called Jumpy Otter,
with Expo, so one codebase runs on iOS,
Android, and the web.

c2.text: You play an otter hopping through San Francisco. Roads full of traffic, cable car tracks, and the bay, where you hop across floating piers. Blocky voxel art, bright and fun.

c3.text: Use my open-source Jumpy Otter repo on GitHub as the design reference. How would you set that up?

c4.text: Oh, wait, one more thing. Add creatine bottles to collect, and a combo meter when you hop forward fast.

c5.text: Can you speak a little faster?

c6.text: Put it in the product demo apps repo. Test it in your browser and on the iPhone simulator. Your Mac can't run Android, so start a second Devin on Ubuntu to test it on an Android emulator. Send me a recording of each, then open a PR.
